description: This source file implements JSON response helper functions for error handling, timestamp generation, and JSON timestamp conversion within the JsonResponses namespace.

methods.name: malFormedRequest
methods.description: Creates a JSON response indicating a malformed request with error details and timestamp.

methods.name: notSetResponse
methods.description: Creates a JSON response indicating a not set or unavailable data error with timestamp.

methods.name: pathNotFound
methods.description: Creates a JSON response indicating a requested path was not found with timestamp.

methods.name: noAccess
methods.description: Creates a JSON response indicating access is forbidden with timestamp.

methods.name: valueOutOfBounds
methods.description: Creates a JSON response indicating a value is out of bounds with timestamp.

methods.name: getTimeStamp
methods.description: Returns an ISO8601 UTC timestamp string.

methods.name: getTimeStampZero
methods.description: Returns a zeroed ISO8601 timestamp string for unset values.

methods.name: addTimeStampToJSON
methods.description: Adds current timestamp in seconds and nanoseconds to a JSON object with a suffix.

methods.name: convertJSONTimeStampToISO8601
methods.description: Converts ts_s and ts_ns fields in JSON to an ISO8601 timestamp in ts.
